name: Livermore Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An AVA in Alameda and Contra Costa counties centered on the city of Livermore in the Tri-Valley, inside the San Francisco Bay and Central Coast AVAs. Robert Livermore, a 19th century landowner, planted its first commercial grapevines.
